features.title: Camera capture and the local stream
features.story: As the TV, I want a smooth live picture of the board, so that a judge sees the real thing.
acceptance: Run `python -m reup_eye --hub $HUB_URL` on the laptop and see the board camera (the Facecam) open at 1080p. The station as built has one laptop camera: a second one (aux) is off unless services/eye/config.toml turns it on

A camera with a name in config.toml is only ever opened under that name. If it is unplugged, or the names cannot be listed, nothing is opened in its place, so the eye never looks through a built in webcam. `python -m reup_eye --list-cameras` prints the names and opens nothing
On Windows the camera is opened through Media Foundation first, then DirectShow, each with its own numbering
Open http://localhost:8089/stream/board.mjpg in a browser and see live video at 15 fps or more
Unplug a camera: the eye keeps running, reports that camera offline within 3 seconds, and reopens it when it is plugged back in
Every 5 seconds the eye posts camera health with its counts or alone, as IngestCountsBody.cameras
tests: frame source falls back and retries when open fails
camera health reports fps over a 2 second window
config loads camera names, indexes and the stream port with defaults
a camera is chosen by name in each backend's own numbering
a named camera that is missing never falls back to another camera
a camera plugged in late is found by asking again before every try
a camera that is turned off gets no source

features.title: Zones and the empty board reference
features.story: As the operator, I want to mark zones once and capture the empty board, so that counting is exact.
acceptance: The eye loads zones from GET /api/state at start and again every 2 seconds (it has no socket to the hub, so a `zones` change is picked up by the next poll)
POST http://localhost:8089/reference/board captures and saves the empty board frame for that camera to services/eye/data/ (gitignored); it survives a restart

POST http://localhost:8089/full/board, with the board full, saves the size of one unit for every open zone (a zone holds its part's capacity, or ?z-id=n says otherwise); it survives a restart and is dropped when the zone gets another part

A bumped camera is put back by itself. The eye saves the edges of the picture at the camera's home position (first still picture, or POST /anchor/:camera), finds the slide and the turn of every later picture against it, and moves each frame back before the stream, the zones or the detector see it. After any motion, counts wait for one look that confirms the position (3 seconds at most). A board it cannot find at all holds counts for up to 15 seconds

Motion and the room's brightness are read inside the board only: the corners named in config.toml, or a box around the zones when none are named, so a screen or a person beside the board does not hold the counts
For a pocket zone the eye warps the quad to a flat rectangle and splits it into rows by cols pocket cells in pocket order
GET http://localhost:8089/debug/board.jpg returns the current frame with zones and pocket cells drawn, for checking alignment
tests: quad to rectangle mapping returns the four corners for the four cell corners
pocket cells are numbered row by row from the top left
a saved reference loads back identical
zones parse from the snapshot mock

features.title: Pocket counting on the laptop
features.story: As reup, I want to know which pockets are full, so that the count is never a guess.
acceptance: With the reference captured, each pocket is full when its mean absolute difference from the reference (colour, blurred, gain corrected using the board border) is over the threshold in config; count is the number of full pockets
Take a unit out of a pocket: within 1.5 seconds of the hand leaving, the eye posts a Count with the new pockets array and count, source eye
While anything is moving inside the board quad no count is posted; a count is posted only after 500 ms of stillness
An unchanged count is not posted again, except once every 30 seconds as a keepalive
Dimming the room lights by a third does not change any pocket's state (gain correction)
tests: occupancy on synthetic frames: empty, full, half covered
gain correction cancels a uniform brightness change
settle filter holds counts while motion energy is over the limit and releases after 500 ms
changed-only posting with a 30 second keepalive
the posted body validates as IngestCountsBody

features.title: Open zone counting and outlines
features.story: As reup, I want to count items that do not sit in pockets, and trace every part on screen.
acceptance: For an open zone the eye counts instances of that zone's product found by YOLOE-26. Each product has one example: a whole frame and the box of one of the part in it. The model turns each example into an embedding, the embeddings are joined into one set of classes, and every later frame is looked at with no prompts

POST http://localhost:8089/prompt/:zoneId?box=x0,y0,x1,y1 saves the current frame and that box as the example for the zone's part (several boxes, split by a semicolon, are several of the same part; with no box the whole zone is the example)
A detector count is believed only after it was seen 3 looks in a row with nothing moving, so a hand that hides parts never changes a count. Parts the detector counts need no empty board
The model size and image size come from config; the detector runs in its own thread so the stream never stutters
GET http://localhost:8089/outlines/board.json returns, per detected item, a simplified polygon in normalized coordinates, refreshed at least 3 times a second

If ultralytics or the weights are missing, or a part has no taught example yet, pocket counting and the stream still work and open zones are counted as difference blobs against the empty board; the log says why in one line
Parts that touch on a ledge are one blob. Once the full board is saved a blob counts as its size divided by the size of one unit, and a patch under 0.3 of a unit is not a part
tests: instances are assigned to the zone that contains their centre
polygon simplification keeps at most 24 points
count smoothing: a count must hold for 3 consecutive detections before it is posted
the detector module is not imported when disabled in config
parts the detector counts need no empty board
an example is the whole frame and the boxes of the part in it
touching parts are one patch until the full board is saved

The same item is not posted twice: a new teach needs the spot to be empty for 2 seconds first

features.title: The reorder brain
features.story: As reup, I want a reorder point I can explain in one sentence.
acceptance: packages/brain exports pure functions with no I/O: ratePerDay(dailyUse, alpha=0.3) is the exponentially weighted mean of units used per day, newest day weighted most
reorderPoint = ceil(d*(L+R) + z*sqrt(d*(L+R))) where d = ratePerDay*seasonFactor, L = leadDays, R = reviewDays, z = 1.65; at least 1; at most capacity-1 when capacity is known
orderQty = ceil(d*14), at least 1, and at most capacity minus the current count when capacity is known
daysOfCover = count/d, null when d is 0
reason reads exactly like: "Uses about 0.6 a day. Delivery takes 2 days. Reorder at 4." (singular day when 1)
coverText(days): under 14 days "7 days of cover" (rounded, at least 1), from 14 days "4 weeks of cover" (rounded), null "Not in use yet"

marketNote compares the cheapest ok market quote with the account quote per unit: "Retailer A is $1.20 more per box." or "... less per box."; null when no market quote is ok. The unit word is the first word of product.unit, or unit for each
packsFor(units, packs[]) picks the pack option with the lowest total for at least that many units
tests: rate: constant use, a recent spike weighs more, empty history is 0
reorder point: d=0.56, L=2, R=1 gives 4; d=2.1, L=1, R=1 gives 8; d=2.1 with capacity 6 gives 5
order quantity caps at free space on the board
days of cover, its null case and coverText wording
reason wording, singular and plural
market note more, less, equal and none
packsFor prefers a case when it is cheaper

features.title: Ingest and the count of record
features.story: As reup, I want two cameras to agree on one number.
acceptance: POST /ingest/counts stores counts. For a pocket zone the node's count is the count of record when the node is online at level 2 or more; otherwise the eye's. Open and bin zones use the eye
When the count of record changes, the hub writes a PickEvent with the delta (unless the node already sent one for it), recomputes the Policy with the brain, and broadcasts count, pick and policy
POST /ingest/picks skips ids it has already seen and reports accepted and duplicates
POST /ingest/reaches broadcasts each reach and marks picks within 2 seconds of a reach as handSeen
POST /ingest/node updates NodeStatus and returns zones, reorder points and orders awaiting approval; with no heartbeat for 15 seconds the node is marked offline
If eye and node disagree on a pocket zone for more than 3 seconds, an activity line with tone attention says which zone

features.title: Orders: from the reorder point to received
features.story: As reup, I want to carry an order from noticing to arrival without a person, except for the yes.
acceptance: When a count of record is at or under its reorder point and the product has no order that is not received, failed or cancelled, the hub creates an Order in pricing with a PO number like RU-1042 and sends a market job (unless every market quote is under 10 minutes old) and a cart job
POST /ingest/quotes stores quotes. POST /ingest/cart moves the order to awaiting_approval with unit price, total and the market note, or to failed with the error
POST /api/orders/:id/approve moves awaiting_approval to approved, sends a place job, and sets approvedBy; any other state gets 409
POST /ingest/placed moves the order to placed with the confirmation and eta, or to failed
A spend cap (ORDER_CAP_CAD, default 150, and DAY_CAP_CAD, default 400) fails an order with a clear error before the place job is sent

After an order is placed or shipped, a rising count of record is the delivery: Order.unitsReceived counts it in from the lowest count seen since the order was placed, and the order becomes received when all of it is in or the board is full, with an activity line that says so
POST /ingest/reorder from the node creates the order with trigger node if none is open
POST /api/orders (ops) starts one by hand; POST /api/orders/:id/cancel cancels any order that is not placed

The hub sets snapshot.screen: shop when an order enters pricing or carting, order from awaiting_approval until 20 seconds after placed, then shelf. POST /api/demo/screen overrides it until it is set to null
Jobs not finished are listed by GET /api/jobs, oldest first

When parts are put back and the count of record rises above the reorder point, an order that is still pricing, carting or awaiting approval is cancelled with a line that says why, its jobs are dropped, and the Shelf returns
When a put back leaves the part at or under the reorder point but the order no longer fits on the board, the order is cancelled and opened again for the right amount
Parts put back within 10 minutes of being taken come off that day's use. Parts that arrive on an order, or come back later, are counted as restocked and never change the use
A reorder call from the node is ignored when the hub has a newer count that is above the reorder point

A camera count that drops at least 5 units and more than 3 days of normal use in one change, to the reorder point, opens a count check instead of an order (Snapshot.checks, the checks message). POST /api/checks/:id with right opens the order, with miscount buys nothing. A count back above the reorder point, or reset, clears it. A reorder call from the node waits for the same answer

features.title: Naming a new part with Gemini
features.story: As a shop owner, I want reup to tell me what a part is and where to buy it.
acceptance: POST /api/teach stores the crop (R2 or Durable Object storage), sets TeachState to naming and broadcasts it

The hub fetches Offcut's /catalog.json (cached 5 minutes) and asks the Gemini API (model from GEMINI_MODEL, structured JSON output) to pick the best matching catalog item or none, with a confidence of sure, fairly_sure or not_sure. Search the Gemini docs for the current model name and request shape before writing the call
The suggestion uses the catalog item's name, unit and sku; with no match it uses Gemini's own name and a null sku. State becomes needs_confirm
POST /api/teach/:id/confirm creates the Product, attaches it to the zone, seeds a starting rate of 0.5 a day flagged sampleHistory, and broadcasts product, policy and teach null

GEMINI_MODEL may list several models with commas between. The first is asked, the next is asked too after 2.5 seconds without an answer or at once after a failure, each gets at most 7 seconds, and the first good answer names the part. If none does within 18 seconds the state is failed with a plain error and a typed name still confirms

features.title: Market check on live retailers
features.story: As reup, I want to know the going price before I buy.
acceptance: The buyer connects to the hub WebSocket as role=buyer, reconnects with backoff, and on connect calls GET /api/jobs for anything it missed

For a market job it starts one TinyFish agent run per supplier at once (client.agent.stream), each starting on that supplier's searchUrl with the phrase, with output_schema {listing_name, pack_size, price, currency, in_stock, delivery_days, product_url} all nullable, browser_profile stealth, proxy country from the supplier, and max_duration_seconds 180. Read docs.tinyfish.ai/tinyagent/how-to/compare-prices.md first

The goal tells the agent to close any cookie notice, check the first 5 listings, skip sponsored and bundle listings, return the lowest price before tax and shipping, never add to a cart, never sign in, and stop
A run that ends COMPLETED with a null price, or whose result mentions a captcha or a block, is a failed quote (ok false) with a plain error
Quotes are posted with POST /ingest/quotes; one failed site never stops the others
Suppliers are read from services/buyer/suppliers.json (the two retailers that passed the supplier test)
tests: goal text contains the stop rules

features.title: Seed, sample history and reset
features.story: As the operator, I want the same clean start for every judge.
acceptance: A seed in apps/hub/src/seed.ts holds the suppliers, and 30 days of sample daily use per seeded product (flagged sample), chosen so the demo product (wood screws, capacity 12) has a rate of 0.56 a day and a reorder point of 4; the demo starts with 6 on the board, so taking two crosses the line

POST /api/demo/reset cancels open orders, clears runs, quotes older than 10 minutes and activity, restores sample history and policies, and keeps zones, products and current counts. The one exception: a part taught on the teach spot is removed and the spot is freed, so every judge can teach one

PUT /api/board sets up the station in one call: every zone and every part (contracts/mocks/board.json is the station as built, `npm run board -- <hub url>` sends it). It cancels open orders and clears the demo. Counts of parts that stay on their ledge are kept

A part set up with no capacity sits on a ledge that holds what is stocked. Its capacity is the most the cameras have counted there since the last reset, and reset takes what is on the ledge now as full (an empty ledge holds nothing known)

A part set up on the board has sample use sized to its ledge: the reorder point is two under a full ledge, so taking two of any part crosses its line, and the order is what it takes to fill the ledge again. A ledge with one unit is counted and never reordered
POST /api/demo/season sets the season, recomputes every policy and broadcasts them
POST /api/demo/replay stores the replay switches and includes them in jobs
tests: reset leaves zones and products and clears orders
season recomputes policies
the demo product's reorder point is 4 with the seed
PUT /api/board replaces every zone and part and clears the demo
the first count teaches the capacity, with no pick and no order
taking one of any part orders nothing, taking two orders what was taken
stocking up raises the capacity and the reorder point with it
reset takes what is on each ledge as full

features.title: Deploy and secrets
features.story: As the team, we want one command to put the hub, the screens and the store on the internet.
acceptance: apps/hub/wrangler.jsonc defines the Worker, the Room Durable Object, the D1 database and static assets from apps/web/dist; apps/supply/wrangler.jsonc defines the store and its D1
`npm run deploy` at the root builds web, applies D1 migrations and deploys both Workers
Secrets are pushed from Infisical with one documented line per Worker; none are in the repo
Custom domains are set when DNS is on Cloudflare; until then the workers.dev URLs work and are written in docs/DECISIONS.md
A GitHub Action deploys main after CI passes, using a Cloudflare API token secret
tests: wrangler config files parse and name the bindings the code uses
